briefing: Markets were quiet and neutral today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no broad risk-on signal. Rather than force capital into the market, we added NVDA, the one screened candidate showing full multi-signal technical confirmation, and left the other two open slots unfilled pending a stronger setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a bullish RSI reading, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — to line up together before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認指的是在買入前，等待多項技術訊號（例如RSI處於多頭區間、MACD黃金交叉、股價站上均線、以及成交量放大）同時出現，而不是僅憑單一訊號就進場。這樣可以降低追高或誤判短暫波動的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Both the NASDAQ and S&P 500 posted only marginal gains today, reflecting a lack of major market-moving catalysts. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited clearer directional signals rather than reacting to any single headline event. This kind of low-volatility session typically favors selective, signal-driven stock picking over broad market bets.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日納斯達克指數及標普500指數僅小幅上漲，反映市場缺乏重大消息面刺激。在沒有明確方向性訊號的情況下，大盤呈現窄幅波動格局，投資者普遍採取觀望態度。這種低波動的交易日，通常更適合依據個股技術訊號精選標的，而非全面押注大盤方向。

trades.reasoning: Only candidate with full 4-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) matching the strategy's high-conviction bar despite an otherwise neutral market.
